title: Rust Engineering Lead
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring Rust Engineering Leads of all levels of experience to drive the adoption of this exciting language into the full range of Canonical offerings, starting with Ubuntu but also our own projects and open source offerings. We see Rust as an important new language for system level services and capabilities, and a natural evolution path for the sort of software that would traditionally have been written in C or C++. We believe that there is an opportunity to rethink the foundations of future Linux systems with Rust as a central driver of change in everything from the system firmware and embedded software, bootloaders, up through the kernel and input handling, all the way to the desktop. 

We also want to ensure that Ubuntu is the very best platform for Rust development, offering easy access to the widest range of tooling and capabilities that support cutting edge open source and enterprise development.

This job posting is our general process for Rust engineers of all levels of seniority, for all relevant teams at Canonical. Apply here if you are an exceptional software engineer who prefers to work in Rust. After the first round of interviews we'll find the best fit product team at Canonical for you to progress your application based on your personal interests.

Canonical has substantial projects in Python, Go, C, C++ and we are starting to invest in Rust. For front-end development we prefer React and Flutter.

Join us in our mission to deliver innovative open-source solutions to individuals and enterprises around the world. We expect the highest engineering standards and strong motivation to get things done well in a fully home-based and distributed environment. These roles require extensive personal experience with Linux - the more different versions of Linux the better

Location: we have open roles for Rust engineers in every time zone.

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement well-tested and well-documented software in Rust
  • Advocate for Rust adoption in Canonical and upstream projects
  • Identify projects and codebases that could be prioritised for Rust adoption
  • Debug and fix issues encountered by your users
  • Participate in our engineering process through code and architectural reviews
  • Collaborate with community and colleagues on technical specifications
  • Seek improvements to engineering and operations practices
  • In some cases, deploy and operate services developed by the team
  • Contribute to the success of your product through technical advocacy

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in Computer Science or STEM, or a compelling narrative about your alternative path
  • For more senior roles, experience building, deploying, and operating distributed systems and APIs
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Well-organised, self-starting and able to deliver to schedule
  • Appreciative of diversity, polite and effective in a multi-cultural, multi-national organisation
  • Professional manner interacting with colleagues, partners, and community
  • Experience designing and writing high-quality Rust software on Linux
  • Experience with and passion for Linux at the system level
  • Professional written and spoken English 
  • The work ethic and confidence to shine alongside motivated colleagues
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility, and accountability 
  • Passion, thoughtfulness, and self-motivation 
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Nice-to-have skills we would value

  • Experience developing for Ubuntu
  • Experience with LXD, MicroK8s, SnapD, IoT, Juju, Ubuntu Core, Ubuntu Pro
  • Performance engineering and security experience

We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. title: Field Service Technician
description:
Job Summary:

The Field Service Technician installs, commissions, monitors, diagnoses and repairs pumps, mechanical seals and other Flowserve equipment in various industries, such as oil and gas, petrochemical, steel, mining, sanitation, etc., depending on our customers' area of operation. In this position, the Field Service Technician (FST) offers real-time technical support at customers' plants and provides recommendations for repairs, upgrades and replacements of parts and equipment.

The FST is actively engaged in solving problems and implementing solutions at customer sites. Our team of Field Service Technicians is the face of Flowserve and we rely on them to provide world-class service to our customers, creating a lasting competitive advantage for our products and services.

Responsibilities:

  •     Perform direct, in-person service calls in response to customer requests;

  •     Assess mechanical problems and take action to resolve them promptly;

  •     Work side-by-side with customer personnel and lead work teams as required;

  •     Supervising the complete repair cycle: disassembly, cleaning, inspection, repair and assembly;

  •     Ensure that equipment is installed successfully and on schedule;

  •     Checking equipment before commissioning and start-up and evaluating performance during and after equipment start-up;

  •     Monitoring the maintenance and performance of Flowserve equipment;

  •     Guide customers on proper procedures for operating and maintaining Flowserve products;

  •     Collaborate effectively with Flowserve support organizations, including repair centers, customer service and sales engineering;

  •     Maintain and submit organized and accurate records, including daily reports, jobs quoted, jobs performed, and time and materials charged;

  •     Other duties as assigned;

Requirements:

  •     Mechanical Technician with active CFT;

  •     Experience as a Field Service Technician in a refinery industry;

  •     Knowledge of industrial applications and operations of pumps, valves, seals, actuators and mechanical equipment;

  •     Experience in installing mechanical equipment;

  •     Experience in repairing pump equipment, installing mechanical seals, changing seal faces, gaskets, rings, etc..;

  •     Knowledge of mechanical adjustment by backlash and interference;

  •     Knowledge of metrology and the use of measuring instruments such as pachymeters, external and internal micrometers, tubular micrometers, dial gauges and dial gauges;

  •     Proven ability to read and correctly interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;

  •     Good Outlook, Word and Excel skills;

  •     Intermediate English

  •     An active driver's license with a good driving record is essential for the job;

  •     Willingness to travel and ship, including globally, for long periods;

  •     Willingness to work overtime as required to minimize impact on customers;

  •     Proven ability to correctly read and interpret mechanical technical drawings, cutting drawings and dimensional drawings of equipment;

Desirable Skills:

  •     Advanced English and/or intermediate Spanish desirable;

  •     Professional certifications in this area.

title: AW139 First Officer – Brazil
description:
DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Operates their assigned aircraft in a safe and efficient manner, in strict compliance with Bristow operational standards and all applicable regulations;
  • Places safety and customer service at the forefront in everything they do, both inside and outside the aircraft;
  • Maintains situational awareness throughout the entire operational region with respect to weather conditions, NOTAMs, sea state and customer offshore facility status;
  • Manages passenger movements, aircraft movements, briefings and baggage loading to ensure safety and compliance;
  • Completes necessary flight planning paperwork, preflight, fueling and oversight of manifesting to ensure compliance;
  • Maintains with accuracy both electronic and paper records to include journey logs, personal flight and duty sheets, and aircraft technical logbook times;
  • Reports all aircraft mechanical irregularities by entering them in the aircraft paper and electronic technical log and ensures aircraft is airworthy before, during and after all flights;
  • Facilitates communications with the customer and ensures Bristow is represented in a professional manner;
  • Stays up to date on all Bristow operational and safety procedures;
  • Complies with other duties and assignments as determined by the Lead Pilot / Director of Operations.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Proven experience as a Co-pilot/First Officer in offshore operations in one of the following aircraft (AW139, SK92, EC175, SK76C++);
  • Possess evidence of flight hours, as per the minimum requirements: 500 total flight hours, of which: 250 hours of twin-engine flight and 100 hours of flight in command;
  • Valid US Visa.

Bristow Group will not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, sex, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, veteran status or any other characteristic.

title: Consultor Técnico Vacinas Campanhas
description:

Essa posição ficará baseada em Brasília.

Por que VOCÊ?

Estamos à procura de profissionais com essas características para alcançar nossos objetivos:

  • Experiência prévia na área comercial com foco em prospecção de novos clientes.

  • Conhecimento sobre patologias, gestão de clientes e gestão de território.

Why GSK?

We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. title: Business Services Team Manager
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in more than 80 countries and very few roles based in offices.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are hiring a Business Services Team Manager to lead efficient and effective travel, logistics, event, scheduling, expense policy and administration.

This executive role requires outstanding coordination, planning, decision-making, budgeting, procurement, reporting and management. It is a fast-paced and complex operation in the tech industry.

We coordinate large-scale company events which involve travel for hundreds of people from 80+ countries. We run such events four times a year, a significant investment in our ability to shape culture, teamwork, execution plans and strategy. Our team is responsible for travel procurement and logistics, ensuring that these events run efficiently and safely. Visas, travel complications and unexpected situations make this a complex operation to run efficiently, demanding a rigorous approach and high work ethic in the team.

This team also serves as an independent check on expense claim approval, ensuring fairness and consistency across teams and countries. This requires integrity, transparency and accountability, and a willingness to set and politely defend the same expectations of the most senior and most junior colleagues.

Together these responsibilities amount to tens of millions in operational costs and a significant number of tactical and operational decisions.

Our team also provides traditional 'EA' services for company leads, though they do this across departments and as a consistent service rather than as personal assistants; they set and deliver to expectations on specific kinds of work. They schedule meetings, coordinate monthly reports, handle delegated approvals for travel and expenses, work across teams, coordinate with suppliers, and run small projects or initiatives.

Location: Worldwide, home based, except in locations where we have an office, such as London, Taipei and Beijing

Leadership and accountability


This team has a direct impact on every team at Canonical. It is important for them to have excellent judgment and interpersonal skills, the confidence to hold people accountable and defend positions of policy, and the work ethic to move quickly through a large volume of work. It is also essential that the team participate in every company event, from the planning and venue selection stages to scheduling, operations and safety reviews, to ensure that they establish personal relationships with team leaders and can ensure these events run smoothly.

As a manager, your team would be responsible for

  • Travel approvals, logistics and operations
  • Expense review in line with policies
  • Planning of complex company events four times a year
  • Company offices that provide executive briefing and operational facilities
  • Our global duty of care, health and safety programs with comprehensive policies and practices

What we are looking for

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • An undergraduate degree in a technical or business subject
  • Drive, and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Leadership and management skills
  • Demonstrable good judgement in matters involving money, policy and in-person interactions
  • Ability to work in a global, multicultural organisation
  • Excellent interpersonal skills, curiosity, flexibility
  • Responsibility, accountability, thoughtfulness and self-awareness
  • Result-oriented, with a personal drive to meet commitments 
  • Ability to travel up to four times a year, for company events up to two weeks long

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Travel industry experience
  • Project management experience
  • Event management and operations experience
  • Business and corporate administration experience

What we offer you


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus or commission. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer


We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Billing Analyst II
description:
About Us
Airswift is the leading workforce solutions provider to the STEM industries. For over 40 years Airswift has been transforming lives through the provision of international workforce solutions to STEM industries. Today, we are an integrated team of over 900 employees across 37 countries, supporting over 8,000 contractors globally.
We are a people business – we transform lives through the world of work. We care about wellbeing, community engagement and our planet – we plant a tree for every person placed in a job globally We have a passion for growth, including investing in the development of our people.
We support professionals looking for jobs with exceptional firms in the technology, construction, and engineering sectors.
It's a hybrid schedule (3 days at the office per week) in Rio de Janeiro - Cinelândia.

Role Description

The Billing Analyst will have responsibility for specific client accounts in Airswift's sales ledger covering the North American region. You will join a strong team based in our Rio de Janeiro office and will be tasked with ensuring fully compliant and timely billing for clients under your remit. 

Principle Accountabilities:

  • Assure billing for the assigned client portfolio.
  • Adhere to client billing requirements as per contracts and work orders, call off orders, purchase orders, etc.
  • Liaise closely with consultants on new clients and new client billing requirements.
  • Ensure accuracy and completeness of billing, including recharges to clients.
  • Ensure timely delivery of invoices to clients along with a variety of supporting documentation.
  • Ensure reporting to the Supervisor of any un-invoiced, missed, or incorrect amount that is not billed timely manner to the client or becomes aged.
  • Ensure timely response to clients (external and internal) and report to the direct Supervisor of specific customer requests for timely delivery.
  • Report on funded invoices to the billing supervisor accurately and in a timely fashion.
  • Deliver pro forma invoicing, pre-approvals, SES, etc.
  • Ensure all banking information is correct on invoices as per funded or non-funded category, currency, and billing entity.
  • Follow up on invoices emailed to clients or via consultants to confirm receipt.
  • Reconcile client VMS (vendor management system) with an internal invoicing system to ensure invoices are correctly submitted.
  • Monitor the status of invoices that were previously sent by email, portal, or VMS systems for any rejections that require correction.
  • Ensure intercompany invoices are issued correctly and timely manner between Airswift's legal entities.
  • Work to the month-end deadlines.
  • Compare invoices from Tempest (payroll and billing system) to invoices generated in Amalto to ensure all relevant information has been saved in SharePoint and maintained in line with auditing requirements.
  • Import invoices to Dynamics 365 (financial ERP system), and balance payroll and billing Tempest to D365, ensuring all billing has been captured.
  • Complete submittal logs in a timely fashion and attend weekly submittal meetings with the Billing Supervisor.
  • Ensure all invoices and backups are filed in a shared drive and maintained.
  • Complete queries in a 48-hour turnaround (outside of main invoicing schedules) and maintain and complete query log.
  • Liaise with payroll to validate any payroll adjustments affected by credit notes and complete credit note logs for auditing purposes.
  • Review new client contracts with the Billing Supervisor to ensure all requirements are captured.
  • Ensure Bullhorn (client management system) data is correct and highlight errors to consultants and service teams accordingly.
  • Meet accuracy targets in line with KPIS.
  • Purchase order and work order analysis.
  • Maintain and deliver 3rd party reconciliations and advise the billing supervisor of details to pay – this is working with credit control to ascertain paid invoices (pay when paid basis).
  • Communicate with various parties of the PO analysis ceilings to ensure timely delivery of either renewed PO value or extended PO.
  • Support function for MIDE region invoicing as and when required.
  • Be fully involved in working with credit control to reduce DSO and improve the liquidity of Airswift for the North American region.
  • Follow company policies and procedures, guidelines, and standards.
  • Ad hoc duties as and when required.

Skills, Knowledge, and Experience:

  • 2+ years of experience in billing
  • Knowledge of multi-currency transactions.
  • Knowledge of VAT and WHT is beneficial.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Good communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a challenging environment with the ability to meet deadlines and adapt to changing priorities.
  • Experience in liaising with various internal departments.
  • Focused and dedicated mindset.
  • Good team player with the ability to drive changes and improvements.
  • Knowledge of funding and non-funding.
  • Knowledge of withholding tax (training provided).
  • Excel and Word knowledge are preferred, but training will be given.

What we can offer you

  • Attractive monthly base salary + competitive commission/performance bonus.
  • Genuine career progression opportunities, either locally or globally
  • World-class training programmes and development opportunities.
  • Virtual Onboarding Events exclusively for new hires.
  • Team driven environment, supportive culture with a focus on work-life balance.
  • Career breaks available after one year.
  • Real time recognition through our employee reward platform.
  • Mental Health First Aiders to signpost you to support when you need it.
  • Yearly destination trips as part of our High Flyers program (Dubai, Buenos Aires, etc…)
  • Charity days for various important causes such as Relay for Life and Earth Day.
Our Core Values:
  • Growth  - In life and business, one must grow to flourish and achieve high ambitions. Growth requires change, challenge, risk and sacrifice - we will always choose growth.
  • Life  – Above all else, we value life. The quality of life, both in and outside of work, profoundly influences our well-being and our impact on the world.
  • Excellence  - We deliver, holding ourselves accountable for results. Our customers see excellence in everything we do.
  • Integrity  - We are ethical, open, honest and authentic. People trust us to do the right thing for the right reason.
Visit our website and social media to find out more - 
Disclaimer

They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel so classified. All personnel may be required to perform duties outside of their normal responsibilities from time to time, as needed.
Diversity & Inclusion
At Airswift, we believe that diversity is critical to our success and makes us a great place to work.  We are committed to building an equal opportunity workplace, the more inclusive we are - the better our work will be.

title: Gerente de Projetos Sênior
description:
A NEORIS, agora parte da EPAM, é uma Aceleradora Digital que ajuda empresas a darem o próximo passo em direção ao futuro. Temos mais de 20 anos de experiência como parceiros digitais de algumas das maiores empresas do mundo. O Gerente de Projetos será responsável por estabelecer práticas e diretrizes para a execução de projetos voltados à implementação e evolução de soluções baseadas em API Gateway e DevOps. Este profissional atuará como elo entre equipes técnicas e de negócio, garantindo segurança, agilidade, escalabilidade e governança na entrega de serviços digitais.

Responsabilidades

  • Criar cronogramas e alocar recursos de forma eficiente, evitando desperdícios.
  • Identificar e analisar riscos, desenvolvendo estratégias de mitigação proativas.
  • Gerenciar o progresso do projeto e garantir que os objetivos sejam alcançados dentro dos prazos estabelecidos.
  • Comunicar-se efetivamente com todas as partes interessadas (stakeholders) para manter todos alinhados e informados.

Requisitos

  • Conhecimento em modelagem de APIs (REST, SOAP, GraphQL) com padrões corporativos.
  • Experiência em políticas de segurança e governança no API Gateway.
  • Habilidade para desenhar pipelines DevOps com foco em CI/CD e IaC.
  • Familiaridade em testes funcionais, de segurança e de performance de APIs.
  • Conhecimento em configuração do API Gateway (roteamento, autenticação, rate limiting).
  • Experiência com padrões de arquitetura e segurança, auditoria de logs e métricas de deploy.

Oferecemos

  • Seguro de Vida: Proteção e segurança para você e seus entes queridos.
  • Aulas de Inglês/Espanhol: Incentivo ao aprendizado de idiomas.
  • Wellhub: Benefícios e descontos em academias e programas de bem-estar.
  • Auxílio Creche: Suporte financeiro para despesas com educação infantil.

title: Analista de Engenharia
description:
Sobre a empresa:

Uma indústria de ideias a serviço do progresso.
Liderança. Confiança. Expertise.

Fundada em 1954 com o objetivo inicial de atuar nas áreas de investigação e sondagem de solos, a Sondotécnica foi, ao longo do tempo, ampliando sua gama de serviços, passando a oferecer estudos de barragens e ingressou na consultoria para a construção de hidrelétricas. Foi pioneira nas áreas de hidrologia, oceanografia e transporte de sedimentos, também adquiriu conhecimento de estruturas, elaborando projetos de edifícios, complexos industriais e até pontes. Com o forte investimento em pesquisa, treinamento e qualificação, a empresa diversificou sua área de atuação e hoje presta serviços em vários segmentos de infraestrutura, com foco na execução dos projetos, gerenciamento, fiscalização e supervisão de obras. A Sondotécnica hoje é líder em consultoria de engenharia no Brasil, com mais de 3 mil projetos executados e mais de 400 clientes atendidos. Hoje, a Sondotécnica oferece sua expertise para empreendimentos nos setores de: – Transporte – Saneamento – Habitação – Urbanização – Energia – Indústria – Meio Ambiente – Irrigação.

  • Auxílio no dimensionamento e detalhamento de projetos de estruturas de contenção, aterros sobre solos moles, estabilidade de taludes de solos e rochosos, fundações e estruturas enterradas, instrumentação, rebaixamento de lençol freático;
  • Programação, acompanhamento, controle de medição e interpretação de investigações geológico-geotécnicas;

Requisitos:

  • Experiência: Desejável experiência com projetos geotécnicos na área de estruturas de contenções, estabilidade de taludes, tratamento de aterros sobre solos moles e fundações. Familiaridade com BIM será um diferencial.

description:
Welcome to Haleon. We're a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we've grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.

Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Voltaren, Theraflu, Otrivin, and Centrum – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.

Now it's time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Quer fazer parte de uma empresa líder mundial em saúde do consumidor que tem como propósito entregar a maior saúde diária com humanidade? Quer contribuir para impactar a vida de bilhões de pessoas por meio de grandes e reconhecidas marcas, como Sensodyne, Centrum, Advil, Eno, Sonrisal, Corega, CataflamPro, Sonridor e outras, e poder ir além em um ambiente que celebra a diversidade?

Então, confira a oportunidade abaixo e venha fazer parte do nosso time Haleon

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Gerênciar e garantir a realização de eventos para dentistas em instituições de ensino de acordo com a meta e estratégia traçada para os distritos;

  • Compreender os conceitos e ferramentas de produtividade sobre auditorias de mercado oferecidas pela Haleon e utilizar para elaboração do plano tático;

Por que VOCÊ?

Suas qualificações:

  • Ensino Médio Completo; desejável Ensino Superior Completo ou em andamento;
  • Experiência em vendas, preferencialmente como propagandista, porém podendo também ter trabalhado em outros segmentos;

  • Perfil dinâmico, ágil e com facilidade de aprender;

Job Posting End Date

Equal Opportunities
Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

We'll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence.

Note to candidates

  • Apoiar na análise crítica dos serviços mecânicos executados, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e ajustes operacionais.

  • Identificar interferências e inconsistências entre projetos e condições reais de campo, apoiando na proposição de ajustes técnicos.

Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Domínio do Pacote Office e ferramentas de CAD, especialmente AutoCAD e Revit.

  • Capacidade de análise de documentos técnicos da obra (RDOs, registros fotográficos, etc.).
  • Conhecimento básico de normas técnicas e regulamentações aplicáveis à indústria de dispositivos médicos (RDCs, Anvisa, NBR), especialmente voltadas para sistemas de HVAC.
  • Conhecimento das exigências de ar condicionado para ambientes controlados: controle de temperatura, umidade, pressurização e particulados.

Perfil desejado:

  • Atenção aos detalhes, senso crítico e proatividade.

title: Digital Catalog Strategy Sr Manager
description:
About Sony Music Entertainment Brazil


Sony Music Entertainment Brazil is one of the country's leading entertainment groups and part of the global Sony Music Entertainment family. Our mission is to drive music and culture forward by connecting artists and fans through innovation, creativity, and operational excellence. We operate across all segments of the music industry, from developing new talent to celebrating an iconic catalog, always with the goal of inspiring and transforming through music.

We are looking for a Senior Manager, Digital Catalog Strategy, who is passionate about music and deeply connected to the digital landscape. This person will be responsible for leading strategic initiatives aimed at enhancing the performance, visibility, and relevance of the company's catalog across streaming platforms, social media, and other digital channels.

The primary focus of this role is to maximize engagement and consumption of the catalog, from timeless classics to major hits, connecting different generations of fans through content, storytelling, and digital innovation.

What you'll do:

  • Lead a diverse team, fostering integration with local (Sony and Som Livre) and international teams.
  • Be responsible for catalog repertoire KPIs and overall performance goals for Sony/Som Livre.
  • Test and model new strategies to grow catalog music audiences across major digital platforms (Spotify, YouTube, Amazon, Apple, Deezer, etc.).
  • Plan and manage the area's budget efficiently, investing in: content marketing, paid media, channel optimization strategies, creative projects and events, page and game creation,influencer partnerships and other innovative initiatives.
  • Ensure the effective execution and tracking of action plans, campaigns, projects, and events.
  • Analyze performance and conversion results, implementing data-driven improvements.
  • Collaborate closely with other Sony teams (Sales, Playlist Strategy, BI, Creative, Media, Marketing, and A&R) to analyze user behavior, generate insights, test hypotheses (A/B testing), and optimize revenue by reducing media dependency.
  • Stay up to date with market trends in music, digital marketing, and UX.

Who you are:

  • Loves music and is an active user of streaming platforms.
  • Is results-driven and focused on the company's key KPIs.
  • Has strong strategic thinking and structured reasoning.
  • Demonstrates excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Responds calmly under pressure and manages conflicts and risks effectively.
  • Communicates clearly with cross-functional stakeholders at multiple levels, building trust and credibility.
  • Can create compelling, storytelling-driven presentations.
  • Is proactive, self-motivated, and enjoys sharing knowledge and fostering team collaboration.
  • Manages time and resources efficiently, setting priorities and delegating effectively.
  • Is engaged in developing the team, offering fair and constructive feedback, and empowering people to make responsible and assertive decisions.
  • Is curious, creative, and constantly seeking innovative ways to act in the market.
  • Shows resilience when facing challenges, adapts easily to change, and stays aligned with evolving business needs.
  • Demonstrates self-awareness, works on personal development points, and identifies opportunities for professional growth.

Requirements:

  • Fluent English and Intermediate Spanish.
  • Degree in Engineering, Economics, Data Science, Marketing, Advertising, or Business Administration.
  • Postgraduate degree or MBA in Marketing and/or Business Administration.
  • 10+ years of professional experience.
  • 3+ years of team management experience.
  • Strong background in Marketing, Digital, or Growth within music, tech, media, digital marketing agencies, or social media companies.
  • Advanced knowledge of Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Canva.
  • Experience with Google Ads (Search, Display, and YouTube), Facebook Ads, YouTube Analytics, and Facebook Insights.
  • Experience using AI tools such as Copilot, ChatGPT, or Gemini to increase work efficiency.
  • Knowledge of SEO strategies, UI/UX best practices, viral marketing, content marketing, and growth hacking.

What we give you:

  • Join an inclusive, collaborative, and global community where you can channel your passion every day.
  • Work in a modern environment designed to inspire productivity, creativity, and teamwork, empowering you to do your best work.
  • Benefit from investment in your growth and professional development, helping you thrive within our vibrant community.
  • Enjoy the freedom to accelerate progress, innovate, and shape what's next.
  • Be part of a company that drives positive change and contributes to social impact, diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives.
  • Access a comprehensive benefits package that supports you and your family, from wellness programs to paid time off that helps balance your professional and personal life.
  • Enjoy additional time off during the end-of-year holidays.

title: recepcionista para clinica medica
description:
A principal função de uma recepcionista de clínica médica é ser o primeiro ponto de contato entre os pacientes e a clínica, realizando atendimento, agendamentos e organização geral para garantir um bom fluxo de trabalho e a satisfação do paciente. As tarefas incluem atender chamadas, recepcionar presencialmente, agendar consultas e exames, confirmar agendamentos e lidar com questões administrativas, como contato com convênios para autorizações.

Funções administrativas e de organização

  • Agendamento:
     Marcar consultas, exames e procedimentos, além de confirmar os compromissos com os pacientes.
  • Atendimento:
     Atender pacientes e visitantes presencialmente, por telefone e por e-mail, respondendo a dúvidas e orientando-os.
  • Documentação:
     Organizar guias de consultas e exames, abrir fichas ambulatoriais e, quando necessário, contactar convênios para autorizações.
  • Gestão de fluxo:
     Controlar a entrada e saída de pacientes das salas de atendimento e auxiliar na organização dos espaços.

Funções de atendimento e relacionamento

  • Acolhimento:
     Recepcionar os pacientes de forma acolhedora, prestando um atendimento cordial e humanizado.
  • Comunicação:
     Transmitir informações com clareza, tanto para os pacientes quanto para a equipe médica e administrativa.
  • Resolução de problemas:
     Lidar com situações difíceis com tato, paciência e boa comunicação.
  • Feedback:
     Contribuir para o bem-estar do paciente enquanto ele aguarda o atendimento, sendo responsável pela primeira impressão que ele tem da clínica.

title: Hedge Accounting Specialist
description:
Job Purpose


We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Hedge Accounting Specialist to join our finance team. The successful candidate will be responsible for the end-to-end process of hedge accounting, including derivative instruments analysis, hedge effectiveness assessments, and accounting under ASC 815 (or IFRS 9, as applicable).

Job Description



•    Derivative Instruments Accounting & Analysis: Monitor, account for, and analyze all derivative transactions including forwards, swaps, options, and futures. Ensure proper classification and valuation in accordance with hedge accounting standards.
•    OCI (Other Comprehensive Income) Analysis: Prepare and review OCI entries related to hedge accounting. Analyze fluctuations and report impacts on financial statements.
•    Hedge Cost Allocation: Analyze and allocate hedge costs between business units or cost centers. Track cost of hedging strategies (e.g., forward points, option premiums) and ensure correct accounting treatment.
•    Spot and Forward Points Rate Analysis: Perform in-depth analysis on spot vs. forward points movements and their impact on hedging relationships and financial results.
•    Mark-to-Market (MTM) Analysis: Calculate and explain changes in the fair value of derivative positions. Work with valuation models and external pricing sources.
•    Hedge Effectiveness Testing & Documentation: Execute prospective and retrospective effectiveness tests (qualitative and/or quantitative). Maintain comprehensive documentation for audit and compliance purposes.
•    Collaboration & Reporting: Work closely with Treasury, FP&A, and external auditors to ensure the accuracy and transparency of hedge accounting results. Prepare reports and dashboards as needed for internal stakeholders.
•    Compliance & Controls: Ensure adherence to internal controls and compliance with accounting standards such as ASC 815 or IFRS 9. Support external and internal audits as required.
•    FX Analysis - Conduct detailed Foreign Exchange variance analysis to identify and explain deviations in currency conversion impacts across global transactions enabling data-driven insights.

You are meant for this job if:



•    Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or Economics (MBA is a plus)
•    Experience in hedge accounting, financial reporting, or treasury operations
•    Strong understanding of derivative instruments and financial risk management
•    In-depth knowledge of hedge accounting under ASC 815 and/or IFRS 9
•    Proficient in Excel and financial systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, Kyriba, or similar treasury systems)

Skills


Communication Analytical Skills Risk Management

title: pesquisador de desenvolvimento analítico pl
description:
Se você é apaixonado por pesquisar e desenvolver medicamentos e novas opções terapêuticas, movido por desafios, melhorias e tendências de mercado, comprometido com os resultados e tem brilho nos olhos ao atuar com inovações, essa oportunidade é para você #Vem Ser FQM
O Grupo FQM é uma empresa da Indústria Farmacêutica que atua há 93 anos no Brasil (desde 1932), faz parte do Grupo Roemmers, multinacional com sede na Argentina, posicionado entre os cinco maiores grupos farmacêuticos da América Latina. No Brasil, a FQM ocupa a 12ª posição do ranking da Indústria Farmacêutica com faturamento acima de 2 bilhões de reais ao ano. Com um amplo portfólio de medicamentos, suplementos, cosméticos atua em 02 segmentos: Medicamentos de prescrição médica (RX) em diversas especialidades terapêuticas, e consumo (OTC) produtos para o autocuidado, isentos de prescrição médica, destinados diretamente ao consumidor final.
A FQM, com mais de 1500 colaboradores, vem escrevendo sua história através de constante aprimoramento do seu portfólio de produtos e processos e da busca incessante pela inovação e excelência para atender às necessidades do mercado farmacêutico no país, promovendo Saúde, Autoestima, Bem-estar e Qualidade de Vida à toda população.

Desenvolver e validar metodologias analíticas para serem utilizadas pelo Controle de Qualidade para confirmar a qualidade das matérias-primas e dos produtos. Conduzir Estudos de Estabilidade a fim de determinar o prazo de validade dos produtos.
 
Local de trabalho: Jacaré/Rio de janeiro.

Elaborar os protocolos e executar testes experimentais de desenvolvimento e/ou validação das metodologias analíticas para métodos de identificação, teor, uniformidade de conteúdo, dissolução e substâncias relacionadas;
Desenvolver metodologias indicativas de estabilidade e executar os testes de degradação forçada dos insumos farmacêuticos ativos e produtos;
Elaborar monografias de análise dos produtos, insumos e matérias primas;
Executar análises físico-químicas relacionadas aos estudos de estabilidade dos produtos;
Elaborar documentação dos produtos em estabilidade, emitindo laudos, pareceres e relatórios técnicos dos resultados observados;
Elaborar/Revisar procedimentos operacionais padrão dos equipamentos e atividades do setor de acordo com a demanda;
Elaborar o dossiê dos produtos e pesquisas sob responsabilidade de sua área de atuação, compilando todos os documentos relativos à condução das atividades de desenvolvimento analítico, visando a submissão na ANVISA.
Contribuir para investigações analíticas, "troubleshooting", desvios e análises de tendência;
Garantir o cumprimento das Boas Práticas de Laboratório (BPL) e diretrizes de integridade de dados

title: Aprendiz em RH
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We're a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we've grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne, Panadol, Advil, Voltaren, Theraflu, Otrivin, and Centrum – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
Now it's time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

Quer fazer parte de uma empresa líder mundial em saúde do consumidor que tem como propósito entregar a maior saúde diária com humanidade? Quer contribuir para impactar a vida de bilhões de pessoas por meio de grandes e reconhecidas marcas, como Sensodyne, Centrum, Advil, Eno, Sonrisal, Corega, CataflamPro, Sonridor e outras, e poder ir além em um ambiente que celebra a diversidade?

Então, confira a oportunidade abaixo e venha fazer parte do nosso time Haleon
 

Principais responsabilidades:

  • Apoiar e impulsionar iniciativas que promovam uma jornada positiva para todos os colaboradores, desde o onboarding até o desenvolvimento contínuo;
  • Colaborar no desenho, implementação e melhoria contínua de programas de experiência do colaborador, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho positivo, desenvolvedor e engajador;
  • Atuar no processo de integração de novos colaboradores, garantindo uma experiência acolhedora e eficiente;
  • Apoiar a aplicação e análise de pesquisas de engajamento, contribuir para programas de reconhecimento e colaborar na elaboração de planos de ação com base no feedback dos colaboradores;
  • Participar da criação e divulgação de conteúdos, eventos e campanhas internas que reforcem os valores da Haleon e fortaleçam as ações e processos de RH.

Por que VOCÊ?
Suas qualificações:

  • 18 a 22 anos de idade;
  • Ensino Médio completo;

 Job Posting End Date

Equal Opportunities

Haleon are committed to mobilising our purpose in a way that represents the diverse consumers and communities who rely on our brands every day. It guides us in creating an inclusive culture, where different backgrounds and views are valued and respected – all in support of understanding and best serving the needs of our consumers and unleashing the full potential of our people. It's important to us that Haleon is a place where all our employees feel they truly belong.
During the application process, we may ask you to share some personal information, which is entirely voluntary. This information ensures we meet certain regulatory and reporting obligations and supports the development, refinement, and execution of our inclusion and belonging programmes that are open to all Haleon employees. 
The personal information you provide will be kept confidential, used only for legitimate business purposes, and will never be used in making any employment decisions, including hiring decisions.

Adjustment or Accommodations Request

If you require a reasonable adjustment or accommodation or other assistance to apply for a job at Haleon at any stage of the application process, please let your recruiter know by providing them with a description of specific adjustments you are requesting. We'll provide all reasonable adjustments to support you throughout the recruitment process and treat all information you provide us in confidence. 

Note to candidates

The Haleon recruitment team will contact you using a Haleon email account ). If you are not sure whether the email you received is from Haleon, please get in touch.

title: Analista de Dados Sr
description:
Somos a IPmedia

Uma startup de tecnologia com diversos produtos no mercado de encontros online, com mais de 9 anos de operação. Somos uma empresa apaixonada por tecnologia que deseja quebrar as barreiras de distância entre as pessoas, através de novas tendências e crescimento.

Em nosso ambiente colaborativo e inovador, enfatizamos a liberdade de trabalhar de qualquer lugar do mundo ou no conforto da sua própria casa, promovendo um livre fluxo de ideias. Valorizamos o desenvolvimento e o crescimento de nossos profissionais, oferecendo cursos de treinamento e oportunidades de aprendizado. Trabalhamos com tecnologias de ponta, tanto no desenvolvimento quanto na infraestrutura.

Requisitos:

Procuramos um Analista Sênior que seja hands-on com SQL e Python que goste de desenvolver pessoas.
Você vai liderar um time de 2 analistas de dados, sendo responsável por definir padrões, revisar entregas, fazer pair programming e garantir a excelência técnica do grupo, sempre com a mão no código.
Queremos alguém que escreva SQL diariamente ao mesmo tempo que ensine o time a pensar em performance, legibilidade e escalabilidade.

O que você vai fazer:

  • Liderar o time de BI, orientando tecnicamente, revisando código e conduzindo sessões de aprendizado prático.
  • Escrever e otimizar queries SQL complexas em MySQL 8 (core) e PostgreSQL (novos serviços).
  • Ser responsável por lógicas críticas de atribuição de tráfego e produto, com impacto direto na receita e nas decisões estratégicas.
  • Guiar decisões de modelagem e estruturação de dados, garantindo coerência entre dashs, processos e camadas analíticas.
  • Estabelecer padrões de boas práticas SQL e modelagem relacional, promovendo consistência e qualidade a longo prazo.
  • Fazer pair programming e code reviews, ensinando na prática e elevando o nível técnico do time.
  • Trabalhar lado a lado com engenharia e produto, assegurando que as decisões de negócio estejam refletidas corretamente nos dados.
  • Apresentar os KPIs semanais e mensais de forma clara e acessível, assegurando que toda a equipe esteja atualizada sobre o desempenho e os resultados.

O que você precisa saber | ter:
Imprescindível:

  • 5+ anos de experiência com SQL em produção, em sistemas com dados críticos ou financeiros.
  • Domínio profundo de índices, execution plans, particionamento e otimização de queries.
  • Experiência sólida com MySQL e PostgreSQL em ambientes produtivos.
  • Capacidade comprovada de mentorar e ensinar você será a referência técnica do time.
  • Vivência com Git workflow colaborativo (branches, pull requests, revisão e versionamento de scripts).
  • Conhecimento consistente de modelagem de dados relacionais e garantia de consistência entre camadas.

Legal se souber | experiência:

  • Experiência prévia em liderança técnica de times de dados.
  • Inglês intermediário ou acima, para leitura de documentação e colaboração com outros times.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de versionamento e deploy de dados (ex: dbt, Liquibase, Flyway).
  • Vivência com monitoramento e auditoria de dados críticos.
  • Experiência em ambientes colaborativos e ágeis, com foco em melhoria contínua.
  • Participação ativa em comunidades técnicas de SQL, PostgreSQL ou MySQL.

title: RODOVIA l COORDENADOR(A) DE COMUNICAÇÃO
description:
Descrição da vaga

Quer mover a sua carreira na Motiva?
A Motiva é o lugar certo para o seu talento, na qual você pode escolher o caminho que deseja seguir juntamente com uma empresa que promove a melhoria da qualidade de vida das pessoas por meio da mobilidade. Nos comprometemos em construir uma cultura cada vez mais diversa e valorizamos a inclusão de todas as pessoas independente de cor, etnia, religião, idade, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual ou deficiência, promovendo um ambiente inclusivo e com equidade de oportunidades.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Atuar na comunicação da unidade de negócios, desenvolvendo e implementando estratégias integradas de comunicação externa, interna, digital, imprensa e eventos, alinhadas às diretrizes da Plataforma Motiva. Garantir o posicionamento institucional da unidade junto aos públicos locais, fortalecendo a imagem da marca e promovendo relacionamento transparente e eficaz com imprensa, sociedade e stakeholders.

Ser responsável pela produção e curadoria de conteúdos específicos e regionalizados, assegurando relevância, consistência e agilidade na comunicação. Monitorar continuamente os canais físicos e digitais, antecipando riscos, gerando insights estratégicos e contribuindo para decisões informadas. Atuar com protagonismo na gestão de crises e no atendimento à imprensa em plantões, fora do horário comercial e aos finais de semana.

Principais Desafios

  • Preservar e fortalecer a reputação da Motiva em sua atuação regional, especialmente em momentos críticos.
  • Gerenciar comunicação em situações adversas, garantindo consistência na imagem institucional.
  • Elaborar pautas estratégicas e conteúdos relevantes que ampliem índices de reputação.
  • Atuar de forma integrada com diversas áreas, acompanhando repercussão nas mídias e métricas.
  • Validar entregas de fornecedores e parceiros, assegurando qualidade e prazos.
  • Promover sinergia entre comunicação interna e externa, garantindo consistência na narrativa.
  • Coordenar e desenvolver equipe local, orientando para metas e cultura de excelência.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver e coordenar ações de comunicação externa, interna, digital e eventos.
  • Gerir relacionamento com imprensa local, elaborando pautas, releases e acompanhando publicações.
  • Atuar em regime de plantão para atendimento à imprensa fora do horário comercial.
  • Produzir conteúdos estratégicos e regionalizados, alinhados à identidade da marca.
  • Monitorar canais físicos e digitais, antecipando riscos e gerando insights.
  • Inserir conteúdos em plataformas digitais e apoiar produção de materiais audiovisuais.
  • Garantir execução de contratos com fornecedores e elaboração de briefings claros.
  • Capacitar porta-vozes para entrevistas e eventos, alinhados às diretrizes estratégicas.

Requisitos e qualificações

O Que Esperamos De Você
Inglês e espanhol em nível intermediário;

Graduação em Comunicação ou Jornalismo;

Especialização em mídia, digital, conteúdo e branding.

Você Se Destaca, Se Tiver
Conhecimento em marketing, mídia, digital, conteúdo e branding;

Conhecimento em relacionamento com a imprensa, gramática e redação, relacionamento interpessoal.

Informações adicionais

Ao entrar para o nosso time integrado, você fará parte de uma empresa presente em
13 estados
do país e que movimenta milhares de pessoas diariamente ao oferecer mobilidade de forma íntegra e que gera impacto positivo na sociedade. Aqui, você encontrará diversos benefícios para apoiar o seu desenvolvimento e dar mais movimento para a sua carreira.

Confira Os Benefícios Que Oferecemos
Assistência Médica-Hospitalar;

Assistência Odontológica;

Seguro de Vida;

Vale Refeição ou Alimentação;

Vale Transporte ou Estacionamento no local;

Previdência Privada;

Licença Estendida: maternidade 180 dias e paternidade 20 dias;

Auxílio Creche;

Wellhub (Gympass);

Day off aniversário (Folga);

PLR (Participação nos lucros ou resultados);

Política de flexibilidade na jornada de trabalho, e muito mais

Quer melhorar a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade e contribuir para chegarmos ainda mais longe? Então, traga o seu talento para a Motiva.
SOBRE A MOTIVA

A Motiva é feita de pessoas interessadas em contribuir para o nosso propósito: melhorar a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade.
Somos referência em infraestrutura de mobilidade no Brasil, liderando o setor com foco na criação de valor sustentável e melhorando a vida das pessoas através da mobilidade. Atuamos em serviços de infraestrutura para mobilidade, focados nos segmentos de concessão de rodovias, trilhos e aeroportos.

São mais de 16 mil colaboradores responsáveis pela gestão e manutenção de 4.475km de rodovias, por onde circulam cerca de 2 milhões de veículos, diariamente. Nos trilhos, administramos serviços de transporte de passageiros de metrôs, trens e VLT, transportando diariamente, 3 milhões de passageiros. E no segmento de aeroportos, com 20 terminais sob nossa gestão, atendemos mais de 40 milhões de clientes anualmente.

Para que os clientes possam chegar em segurança nos seus destinos, a Motiva investe em práticas que reforçam o compromisso com o meio ambiente, com o social e com a governança, construindo infraestrutura, implementando serviços e oferecendo oportunidades.

title: Mechanic III
description:
POSITION PURPOSE (Overview):

Perform preventive and corrective maintenance services on aircraft, ensuring compliance with Brazilian aeronautical regulations, manufacturer manuals, and technical documentation, with the goal of maintaining full operational reliability and airworthiness of the fleet.

MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES:


• Perform maintenance, repairs, and both scheduled and unscheduled inspections on aircraft, in accordance with the Daily Maintenance Report (RDM), Work Orders (OS), Maintenance Sheets, and manufacturer manuals, ensuring full adherence to the Aircraft Maintenance Program and regulatory standards.


• Conduct pre-flight, between-flight, and post-flight inspections, ensuring that all items listed in the relevant inspection sheets are verified and that the aircraft is in safe operating condition for all planned missions.


• Execute scheduled inspections and component replacements according to the maintenance planning system (RAMCO), ensuring that all required inspections and component life limits are properly followed.


• Perform troubleshooting and corrective actions on mechanical, hydraulic, and pneumatic systems, following manufacturer procedures and safety standards.


• Record all maintenance activities accurately in the applicable logs and systems, ensuring traceability, compliance, and alignment with the company's quality and safety management system.


• Support the continuous improvement of maintenance processes by suggesting technical and procedural enhancements that increase efficiency, safety, and reliability.


• Maintain the work area organized and compliant with safety and cleanliness standards, preventing risks and ensuring a safe working environment.


• Provide technical guidance and share best practices with lower-level mechanics, supporting the development of less experienced team members.


• Perform other related duties as assigned, within the scope of the position and the company's operational needs.

title: Associate Director of Creative, Acquisition
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growthe

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders' contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We're looking for a visionary creative leader with deep experience in developing ad concepts for digital paid media advertising formats on Meta, TikTok, and other channels. You're able to dive deep into the pixels and give tactical feedback on design and video, but understand how to thread the needle between performance frameworks, creative testing, and world-building assets. You're likely a Creative Strategist by trade with a background in Design, Video Editing, or Performance Marketing. You are hyper-focused on paid media performance and developing advertisements that sell products and services.

You'll work on our Performance Creative service—our Al-powered creative strategy engagement for paid media clients that want to work with us on the following:

  • Expertise: Engage us for our expertise in creative strategy, which includes assessing the efficacy of their ad hooks, ad bodies, and general creative direction. You will have a clear perspective on how to improve this over time.

  • Sales: Deliver game changing creative ads that sell their products and services better than anyone else.

  • Diversity: Increase the creative diversity of their ad program through the use of multiple ad formats: statics, motion, video, UGC, AI.

  • Volume: Increase the volume of their performance creative program by delivering upwards of new ads per month with the intention of scaling that as needed.

This role is for individuals who want to be at the forefront of digital advertising, AI in marketing, and join a team that is building the best creative advertising culture in the business. You will work directly on our Creative Team, which works with our clients to enhance their Creative Output. You will also work with both our Social Commerce team to enhance UGC creative and our Paid Media team to plug into their ad scaling strategies. Generally, your work will be the lifeblood of our ad programs.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives at the intersection of creativity, AI, and performance - combining bold visual storytelling with data-informed design decisions. You'll report to the Director of Creative and lead the management of Designers and Editors to execute paid media assets across a variety of formats, including static ads, short-form videos, motion graphics, and UGC content. Your work will directly impact client performance by delivering a high-volume of ad concepts, elevated creative direction, and data-backed testing frameworks.

This is a fully remote role operating in the EST Time Zone and all business is conducted 100% in English.

What you'll do:

  • Creative Strategy: Lead high-tempo creative strategy and direction for full-funnel ad programs, typically Meta and TikTok, but also YouTube, Amazon, and Display Platforms.

  • Short Form Video Expert: Deliver expert advice, concepts, directions, and briefs to sell products and services through short-form video.

  • Data Analysis: Translate client's marketing strategy and performance data into clear, compelling ad concepts (This includes using metrics like thumb-stop rate, hold rate, and clickthrough rate. You're super comfortable adapting creatives to impact these metrics.)

  • Cross-Team Collaboration: Brief Designers and Editors on the creation of assets including static ads, animations, mobile-first videos, and storyboards for short-form content. You're capable of jumping into shape up a design in Figma or whip up an ad yourself without concern, if need be. This isn't the role for strategy-only folks.

  • Executive Presentation: Present creative work to stakeholders and clients with clarity, confidence, and strategic rationale.

  • Performance Iteration: Monitor performance data in collaboration with the marketing team to inform creative iterations and improve results over time.

You should apply if this sounds like you:

  • 3+ years of creative strategy work on performance ad programs, with specific focus working on short form video and statics. If you have not made any short-form video or driven creative strategy on Meta, this role is not for you.

  • A digital portfolio showcasing performance ad work that includes short-form video, motion, and statics. Examples of what you did to impact metrics like hold rate or CTR. Evidence of strong creative diversity that includes both highly designed and low-fidelity creative.

  • You can storyboard, cut, and ship ads. You can jump into Figma to fix hierarchy and pacing, and into Photoshop or Illustrator to polish assets. Strategy-only folks will not be a fit.

  • You speak in hooks, angles, and metrics. You know thumb-stop rate, 3-second hold, hook retention, CTR, and CPA, and you use them to decide what to test next.

  • You already use tools like ChatGPT, Midjourney, Perplexity, Icon, Runway, or similar to increase speed and volume. You have shipped ads with AI-assisted elements, not just experiments.

  • You're an excellent communicator, both in writing and when presenting to clients. You give crisp, actionable feedback to designers and editors and know how to navigate pushback from clients

  • You can turn vague goals into testable concepts, track results, and call the next iteration without hand-holding.

  • Deep in Figma including Auto Layout, Components, and handoff. Strong in Adobe Creative Suite.

Hard disqualifiers

  • No Meta performance creative ad experience.

  • No portfolio link or no performance context.

  • Strategy-only with no hands-on design ability.

  • Not excellent in client presentation and salesmanship.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you'll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

We are hiring a Software Engineer to work on Linux, cloud infrastructure, pipelines and automation, and open source software.

You will work closely with Amazon, Microsoft, Google and other world-class cloud partners to make Ubuntu the best platform there is in the clouds. Your time will be split between build system development (using Python, Jenkins and shell), implementation of cloud-related features within Ubuntu Server itself, operation of our continuous delivery pipelines, and direct partner engagement. You will strive to automate the delivery of existing and new Ubuntu products applied to all modern workloads from web servers to GPU-aided AI for servers, VM's and containers, and integrate our products with cloud native services.

Come build a rewarding, meaningful career working with the best and brightest people in technology at Canonical, a growing international software company. As a part of our team, you will combine software development skills with software and infrastructure delivery experience.

What the role entails

  • Build automated, highly reliable image delivery, testing and publication pipelines
  • Design, build and integrate new features and enhancements into Ubuntu that will support users of Ubuntu in public clouds
  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Write high quality code to create new features
  • Design and architect complex new systems and integrations with the clouds
  • Debug issues and produce high quality code to fix them
  • Review code produced by other engineers and participate in design discussions
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks for internal and external events
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open source community and commercial partners

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • You have a Bachelor's or equivalent in Computer Science, STEM or similar degree
  • You have practical experience with public clouds
  • You have interest and experience with at least 3 of the following: containers (docker, kubernetes, etc.), devops automation, open source projects, APIs, Linux systems administration, Python packaging, cloud-based applications
  • at least experience in Python software development on Linux

What we offer colleagues


We consider geographical location, experience, and performance in shaping compensation worldwide. We revisit compensation annually (and more often for graduates and associates) to ensure we recognise outstanding performance. In addition to base pay, we offer a performance-driven annual bonus. We provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. We balance our programs to meet local needs and ensure fairness globally.

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass, and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical


Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Working here is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer


We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Especialista em Projetos e Processos
description:
SOBRE A CAPCO

A CAPCO é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes, temos 33 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico Se você mora no Rio de Janeiro - RJ ou região, dê uma olhada

OBJETIVO

Atuar estrategicamente em subeixos como conformidade, desenvolvimento de competências, negócios, processos, projetos, cadeia de suprimentos e transformação digital, por meio da coordenação técnica, análise crítica, identificação de riscos e oportunidades, e desenvolvimento de soluções e melhorias nos processos organizacionais, oferecendo consultorias especializadas que contribuam para a eficiência, inovação e evolução contínua das atividades.

ATIVIDADES

Atuar nos subeixos de conformidade, desenvolvimento de habilidades e competências, negócios, processos, projetos, cadeia de suprimentos e transformação digital, realizando a coordenação técnica, análises críticas, apoio estratégico, otimizações, estudos técnicos, condução de trabalhos técnicos especializados, desenvolvimento de soluções, melhoria dos processos e atividades, consultorias, identificação de riscos e oportunidades.

ESCOLARIDADE

Pós-graduação: Com carga horária mínima de 360 horas de acordo com os subeixos de atuação.

Graduação: De acordo com o descrito em cada perfil abaixo:

Perfil 1 :Comunicação e Marketing Digital

Escolaridade: Comunicação ou áreas correlatas, tais como Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing, Administração, Análise de Sistemas ou áreas afins, preferencialmente com pós-graduação ou cursos de especialização em Marketing Digital, Comunicação Integrada ou Gestão de Mídias Digitais.

Experiência: Liderança de equipes multidisciplinares nas áreas de comunicação e marketing digital, atuando de forma estratégica no desenvolvimento, execução e gestão de projetos de comunicação corporativa, branding, campanhas digitais e posicionamento de marcas.

Conhecimentos: Domínio de ferramentas e estratégias de comunicação digital, incluindo gestão de redes sociais, planejamento de conteúdo, campanhas de mídia paga, SEO, analytics, inbound marketing, automação de marketing e relacionamento com influenciadores. Capacidade de análise de métricas e resultados, visando otimização de ações e aumento do engajamento e conversão.

Requisitos desejáveis: Habilidade para liderar equipes, gerir projetos simultâneos, promover inovação, estimular o desenvolvimento contínuo dos colaboradores e garantir alinhamento das ações de comunicação aos objetivos organizacionais; Experiência em gerenciamento de crises de imagem, elaboração de relatórios executivos, interface com áreas internas e externas e atuação orientada por resultados.

Perfil 2: User Experience Designer

Escolaridade: Design, Comunicação, Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia, Psicologia, ou áreas afins, preferencialmente com especialização ou cursos de extensão em UX/UI Design, Design de Interação, Experiência do Usuário ou áreas correlatas.

Experiência: Em projetos de UX/UI Design, com apresentação de portfólio que evidencie resultados concretos, cases de sucesso e participação em todas as etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos digitais focados na experiência do usuário. Domínio do processo completo de UX Design, incluindo pesquisa com usuários (UX research), definição e desenvolvimento de personas, mapeamento de jornadas do usuário, elaboração de wireframes, prototipação em diferentes níveis de fidelidade (baixa, média e alta) e realização de testes de usabilidade. Habilidade para criar interfaces visuais atraentes, funcionais e acessíveis, com domínio em design de layouts, escolha de esquemas de cores, tipografia e aplicação de elementos interativos, sempre alinhados às necessidades dos usuários e aos objetivos do negócio.

Conhecimentos: Experiência avançada com ferramentas de design e prototipação, especialmente Figma ou similares (Adobe XD, Sketch, etc.).

Requisitos desejáveis: Experiência em design e edição de apresentações profissionais de alto impacto para stakeholders e equipes; Habilidades em edição de vídeos para fins de comunicação, treinamento ou divulgação de produtos digitais; Conhecimento em ferramentas da Power Platform (Power Apps, Power BI, Power Automate); Vivência em ambientes que adotam metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban, com participação ativa em squads de desenvolvimento.

Perfil 3: Cientista de Dados

Escolaridade: Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Estatística, Matemática, Física, ou áreas afins, preferencialmente com especialização em Ciência de Dados, Inteligência Artificial, Machine Learning ou campos correlatos.

Experiência: No desenvolvimento e implementação de modelos de Machine Learning e Inteligência Artificial em ambiente de produção, com apresentação de portfólio que evidencie resultados concretos, casos de sucesso e participação em projetos aplicados à solução de problemas reais.

Conhecimentos: Domínio de técnicas de Machine Learning, incluindo algoritmos supervisionados e não supervisionados, validação de modelos, análise de desempenho e ajuste de hiperparâmetros; Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem estatística (análise multivariada, séries temporais), testes de hipóteses e inferência estatística; Habilidade avançada em programação, especialmente em Python, utilizando as principais bibliotecas e frameworks para ciência de dados, machine learning e inteligência artificial; Experiência com tecnologias avançadas de IA, incluindo Large Language Models (LLMs) e Processamento de Linguagem Natural (NLP).

Requisitos desejáveis: Conhecimento e experiência em ferramentas da Power Platform (Power BI, Power Apps, Power Automate); Vivência em ambientes que utilizam metodologias ágeis, como Scrum e Kanban, com participação em equipes multidisciplinares; Familiaridade com Git para controle de versão e colaboração em projetos de código; Perfil desejado: profissional analítico, inovador, com visão estratégica, capacidade para trabalhar em equipe, comunicação clara e foco em soluções que agreguem valor ao negócio por meio do uso inteligente de dados e IA.

CERTIFICAÇÕES (AO MENOS UMA)

REQUISITOS

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.
